name: OpenMV Cam RT1062
description: A MicroPython-programmable machine-vision camera: 600 MHz i.MX RT1062, 32 MB SDRAM, a 5 MP OV5640 on an M12 mount, plus Wi-Fi/BT, CAN, Ethernet (PoE) and servo outputs. Runs vision code and ML models.

variants.note: R6 revision, two dual-row 8-pin header blocks (14 GPIO), M12 2.8 mm F2.0 lens

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: A full camera computer, not just a sensor. It runs your vision code and talks to the robot MCU over UART, SPI, I²C or CAN (1 Mb/s).
Image pipelines run at about 40 fps at QVGA and below. Full 5 MP stills are possible.
Takes 4.7–5.7 V on VIN and draws about 130 mA active. I/O is 3.3 V and not 5 V tolerant. Swappable sensor modules include global-shutter and thermal.
